Akvayasūri
also Akṣayaśāstrin; of the Mokṣaguṇḍa family; son of Veṅkaṭārya, the [Page009-a. brother of Pakṣadhara Yallayārya; guru of Umāmaheśvara of the Vellāla family, otherwise known a. Abhinavakālidāsa (Bhāgavatacampū, MD. 12328; Tattvacandrikā, MT. 5136 etc.).
--Bhāgavatacampūvyāº.--Ratnāvalī, a C. on his pupil Umāmaheśvara's Bhāgavatacampū. Adyar II. p. 20b. IO. 7256-7. MD. 12331. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 315. Tirupati 320.
Pt.. Madras, 1874. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1902. 8 an. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 585.
